body: Member accounts, gated pages and recurring Stripe subscriptions on your own site, with welcome emails and a CRM record for every member. Describe it and Aglyn AI drafts the pages. Included from the Pro plan.

sections.heading: Questions about membership sites.
body: Members, billing, gating and email, in plain terms.

items.title: How do I create a membership site?
items.body: Build the site, turn on member accounts, mark the pages that are members-only and connect Stripe for recurring billing.

items.title: How do members pay?
items.body: Through Stripe subscriptions on your own site, with no separate paywall or billing tool.

items.title: What are the fees?
items.body: Stripe's processing fee on every plan, plus a small Aglyn platform fee on digital goods and memberships that falls as you move up and reaches zero on the higher tiers. See pricing.

items.title: Can I gate specific pages?
items.body: Yes. Any page can be members-only, and member accounts are built in.

items.title: Can I email members?
items.body: Yes. Welcome emails run on workflows, and campaigns to consented members go out from Marketing on Pro and up.

items.title: Which plan do I need?
items.body: Subscriptions and memberships are included from the Pro plan; the pricing page lists every plan.

items.title: What is Aglyn?
items.body: Aglyn is a website builder with the store, forms, CRM, email, analytics and Aglyn AI built in. It is open source and free to start.

sections.heading: Launch your membership on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — set up members and gating in minutes.
